top_signals.title: Lithuania's Sinkevicius on Russia Threat, US Troops
top_signals.summary: Lithuanian Prime Minister Mindaugas Sinkevicius discusses threats from Russia and the potential of permanently hosting US troops. Sinkevicius is trying to bolster his country’s security as the Kremlin’s full-scale invasion of Ukraine increasingly spills over into the NATO's eastern flank. He talks with Bloomberg's Oliver Crook in Brussels. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
